mapper.select: SELECT A.BILL_ID AS billId , A.BILL_TITLE AS billTitle , A.BILL_AMT AS billAmt , DATE_FORMAT(A.TAX_BILL_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS taxBillDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.PAY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS payDt , CASE WHEN A.ACTUAL_PAY_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isPaid , DATE_FORMAT(A.ACTUAL_PAY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS actualPayDt , A.BILL_REMARK AS billRemark , A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId , B.PROJ_ID AS projId , B.PROJ_NM AS projNm , C.CONT_NM AS contNm , C.CONT_AMT AS totalAmt , C.CONT_REMARK AS contRemark , D.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , D.SALES_CONTENT AS salesContent , E.CUST_NM AS custNm , F.EMP_NM AS salesUserNm , G.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , H.EMP_NM AS mainMgrNm , I.EMP_NM AS subMgrNm FROM TB_BILLING A LEFT JOIN TB_PROJECT B ON A.PROJ_ID = B.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONTRACT C ON B.CONT_ID = C.CONT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SALES D ON C.SALES_ID = D.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER E ON D.CUST_ID = E.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP F ON D.EMP_ID = F.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP G ON C.EMP_ID = G.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP H ON B.M_EMP_ID = H.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP I ON B.S_EMP_ID = I.EMP_ID WHERE A.BILL_ID = #{billId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BILLING WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BILL_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT P.PROJ_ID AS projId , P.PROJ_NM AS projNm , C.CONT_NM AS contNm , C.CONT_AMT AS totalAmt , C.CONT_REMARK AS contRemark , S.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , S.SALES_CONTENT AS salesContent , CUST.CUST_NM AS custNm , U1.EMP_NM AS salesUserNm , U2.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , U3.EMP_NM AS mainMgrNm , U4.EMP_NM AS subMgrNm , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BILL_AMT), 0) FROM TB_BILLING WHERE PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N') AS totalBilledAmt , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BILL_AMT), 0) FROM TB_BILLING WHERE PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND ACTUAL_PAY_DT IS NOT NULL) AS totalPaidAmt FROM TB_PROJECT P LEFT JOIN TB_CONTRACT C ON P.CONT_ID = C.CONT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SALES S ON C.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER CUST ON S.CUST_ID = CUST.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP U1 ON S.EMP_ID = U1.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP U2 ON C.EMP_ID = U2.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP U3 ON P.M_EMP_ID = U3.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP U4 ON P.S_EMP_ID = U4.EMP_ID WHERE P.PROJ_ID = #{projId}

SELECT BILL_ID AS billId , BILL_TITLE AS billTitle , BILL_AMT AS billAmt , DATE_FORMAT(TAX_BILL_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS taxBillDt , DATE_FORMAT(ACTUAL_PAY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS actualPayDt , DATE_FORMAT(PAY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS payDt , ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId FROM TB_BILLING WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY BILL_ID ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ACTUAL_PAY_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACTUAL_PAY_DT) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paidCount, (SELECT IFNULL(CONT_AMT, 0) FROM TB_CONTRACT WHERE CONT_ID = (SELECT CONT_ID FROM TB_PROJECT WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId})) as totalContAmt, IFNULL(SUM(BILL_AMT), 0) as totalBilledAmt, SUM(CASE WHEN ACTUAL_PAY_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ACTUAL_PAY_DT) > 0 THEN BILL_AMT ELSE 0 END) as totalPaidAmt FROM TB_BILLING WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
